title: Screech D'Reazon creates a spark with "One Touch"
htmlContent: Screech D'Reazon's newest single, "One Touch," captures the magic of that life-altering moment when everything shifts, throwing you into a new kind of freedom. The Afrobeat pulse gets a hold of you and propels you along its indomitable groove. This track is a conversation between energy and emotion. Screech D'Reazon achieves simultaneous intimacy and universality, and there's an empty dance floor in there. https://open.spotify.com/track/1ESJVxy82KIYFPirlKUy8f "One Touch" finds its bliss in flexibility. It's the sort of song that will turn a party up to hot but will also nestle comfortably into a late-night, cool-people playlist. It's that fine line between vibrance and relatability where Screech D'Reazon thrives. He is serving up a moment we all know, gift-wrapped in rhythm and rhyme. There's a freshness in this sound, as if Afrobeats had been recast with a revamped swagger. The effect is magnetic, drawing you in on every single beat. If "One Touch" can make everything come true, then Screech D'Reazon just proved that one song can. Connect with Screech D'Reazon on Instagram
